notes: Compact six-band mining and smithing catalog grounded in Lowmark iron, Ridge iron, Emberholt emberstone, Ember Shards, and Ashsteel canon. All gathering outputs are deterministic; forge fuel is station-supplied rather than represented as a shallow inventory item.

items.description: Workable iron-bearing stone mined from Lowmark's shallow pits and Thornfell's ridge seams.
items.purpose: Shared foundation for iron, steel, tools, arrowheads, and later Ashsteel progression.

external_sinks.detail: Lowmark and Thornfell trade workable iron into regional forge economies.

items.notes: The regional identities remain on the world nodes: Lowmark Iron is shallow and accessible; Ridge Iron is cliff-seam iron used for fortified tools.

items.description: A dependable bar of smelted iron suited to practical blades, tools, fasteners, and further refinement.
items.purpose: Concentrates the common iron supply into a reusable cross-skill component.

items.description: Forge-treated iron consolidated into stronger steel for durable field tools and weapon components.
items.purpose: Provides the durable middle progression tier and the structural base for Ashsteel.

external_sinks.detail: Emberholt steel and Thornfell metalwork circulate as practical regional trade goods.

items.notes: Carbon treatment and forge fuel are accounted for by the forge station process, avoiding a single-purpose fuel item.

items.description: Volcanic stone from Emberholt's deep veins that conducts heat and resonance under controlled forging.
items.purpose: Connects Emberholt mining to advanced weapon components and Ashsteel production.
items.notes: Canon describes ember veins, emberstone conduction, and its use in tools and blades.

items.description: A concentrated fragment split from stable emberstone and selected for controlled forging.
items.purpose: Adds a scarce Emberholt input to advanced arrowheads and Ashsteel without creating quest-only material bloat.
items.notes: Matches the canon Ember Shards used in weaponry, forging, conduits, and ritual plates.

items.description: A dark Emberholt alloy forged from steel and concentrated emberstone under tightly controlled heat.
items.purpose: Caps the compact metal chain with a canon material that still depends on early iron.

external_sinks.detail: Finished Ashsteel is a controlled Emberholt export rather than a freely gathered material.

items.notes: Canon identifies Ashsteel as an alloy created during ember surges and used for elite armor.

items.description: Forged nails, pins, and brackets that secure wooden and metal assemblies.
items.purpose: Creates an enduring construction and assembly sink for early iron.

external_sinks.detail: Mechanisms, fabrication, and regional repair systems consume standardized fasteners.

items.notes: Repairs the legacy self-loop by consuming iron bar and producing a distinct quantity of fasteners.

items.description: A practical forged knife for dressing game and routine material preparation.
items.purpose: Provides the early Hunting and Leatherworking cutting tool.

external_sources.detail: Ordinary field knives are stocked by general tool merchants, including before a player can forge one.

external_sinks.detail: Used by Hunting and Leatherworking actions that require a field knife.

items.description: A common iron axe set on a replaceable timber handle.
items.purpose: Provides the first forged Woodcutting tool and a sink for iron and common timber.

external_sinks.detail: Used by entry and low-band Woodcutting actions.

items.description: A serviceable iron mining head mounted to a timber haft.
items.purpose: Closes the early mining-to-smithing tool feedback loop.

external_sources.detail: Basic iron pickaxes are stocked by ordinary tool merchants to bootstrap Mining.

items.description: A batch of simple iron arrowheads ready for fitting to shafts.
items.purpose: Connects early Smithing output to recurring Fletching ammunition sinks.

external_sinks.detail: Consumed by Fletching recipes for common ammunition.

items.description: A durable steel field knife that keeps a dependable edge through repeated dressing and cutting work.
items.purpose: Provides the middle-tier Hunting and Leatherworking cutting tool.

external_sinks.detail: Used by intermediate Hunting and Leatherworking actions.

items.description: A reinforced steel axe balanced for sustained selective cutting.
items.purpose: Carries Woodcutting through the middle progression bands without multiplying regional tool variants.

external_sinks.detail: Used by intermediate and advanced Woodcutting actions.

items.description: A hardened steel pickaxe built for dense ridge iron and Emberholt's volcanic stone.
items.purpose: Supports the middle mining bands and provides a durable sink for steel and timber.

external_sinks.detail: Used by dense iron and non-deep emberstone Mining actions.

items.description: A batch of hardened steel arrowheads for durable general-purpose ammunition.
items.purpose: Extends the recurring Smithing-to-Fletching ammunition loop into middle progression.

external_sinks.detail: Consumed by Fletching recipes for durable ammunition.

items.description: Steel arrowheads fitted with carefully seated Ember Shards for controlled heat conduction.
items.purpose: Gives Ember Shards a focused weapon use while retaining Fletching as the ammunition-finishing skill.

external_sinks.detail: Consumed by Fletching recipes for specialized Emberholt ammunition.

items.notes: A mundane forged component with a canon conductive material; no quest or spellcasting prerequisite is implied.

items.description: A high-grade Emberholt knife whose Ashsteel edge tolerates heat, hide, and repeated hard use.
items.purpose: Provides the capstone Hunting and Leatherworking knife without introducing a niche beast-specific tool.

external_sinks.detail: Used by high-band Hunting and Leatherworking actions.

items.description: An elite Ashsteel axe mounted on a replaceable timber handle.
items.purpose: Provides a compact capstone Woodcutting tool and a final sink for the full metal chain.

items.description: An Ashsteel mining head forged for the hottest, hardest stone in Emberdeep.
items.purpose: Closes the capstone mining tool loop and gates only the deepest Emberholt action.

external_sinks.detail: Required by the deepest high-band Emberholt Mining action.

items.description: A small batch of precisely forged Ashsteel arrowheads for capstone ammunition.
items.purpose: Provides a recurring high-level Smithing sink through Fletching rather than a one-time equipment endpoint.

external_sinks.detail: Consumed by Fletching recipes for capstone ammunition.

gathering_actions.description: Work accessible iron from a shallow pit or exposed ridge seam.
gathering_actions.purpose: Opens the shared Lowmark and Thornfell iron economy with one reusable action definition.
gathering_actions.notes: Lowmark and Thornfell nodes preserve world identity while sharing the same progression mechanic.

gathering_actions.description: Follow denser workable seams deeper into Thornfell's exposed ridge stone.
gathering_actions.purpose: Improves iron yield without adding a redundant second ore item.

gathering_actions.description: Extract stable emberstone from exposed veins without disturbing volatile pockets.
gathering_actions.purpose: Introduces Emberholt's conductive mineral as a later input while keeping the output deterministic.
gathering_actions.notes: Separate Emberholt nodes can reuse this action without duplicating yield logic.

gathering_actions.description: Split concentrated Ember Shards from a stable volcanic cluster.
gathering_actions.purpose: Supplies a focused rare component for advanced weapon fittings and Ashsteel.
gathering_actions.notes: Rarity is expressed through access and progression, not a random drop roll.

gathering_actions.description: Work a richer Emberdeep vein containing both usable stone and concentrated shard material.
gathering_actions.purpose: Raises deterministic throughput and demonstrates one action with multiple guaranteed outputs.

gathering_actions.description: Extract the densest stable stone and shards from Emberdeep's hottest worked veins.
gathering_actions.purpose: Provides the capstone deterministic source for the recurring Ashsteel chain.
gathering_actions.notes: No Glassed Hollow or quest access is assumed.

gathering_nodes.description: A modest worked pit exposing Lowmark's common iron close to the surface.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Shallow pits and small mines in Lowmark's settled agricultural landscape
gathering_nodes.notes: Directly grounded in the Lowmark Iron canon entry.

gathering_nodes.description: A narrow iron seam exposed along a wind-scoured Thornfell cliff.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Accessible cliff seam near maintained ridge paths
gathering_nodes.notes: Shares mechanics with Lowmark iron while retaining Ridge Iron world identity.

gathering_nodes.description: A harder worked face where Ridge Iron runs thick through the stone.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Worked highland quarry above a fortified toolmaking settlement

gathering_nodes.description: A regulated emberstone seam worked within Emberholt's active mining network.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Maintained volcanic gallery near the Emberforges

gathering_nodes.description: An emberstone exposure revealed beside an abandoned Emberdeep shaft.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Edge of an abandoned mining shaft in the Emberdeep Warrens
gathering_nodes.notes: Uses public Emberdeep mining-shaft canon without invoking hidden ritual or quest spaces.

gathering_nodes.description: A concentrated cluster of Ember Shards held in dark volcanic stone.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Heat-scored chamber branching from a regulated emberstone gallery

gathering_nodes.description: A dense Emberdeep seam yielding both workable stone and concentrated shards.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Deep maintained shaft below Emberholt's industrial districts

gathering_nodes.description: A hard, heat-soaked vein reached through Emberdeep's lowest sanctioned workings.
gathering_nodes.world_context: Lowest sanctioned mining gallery in the Emberdeep Warrens
gathering_nodes.notes: Sanctioned industrial context avoids using the Glassed Hollow as repeatable economy content.

recipes.description: Smelt workable Lowmark or Ridge iron into a dependable bar.
recipes.purpose: Establishes the base metal transformation shared by every later Smithing branch.

recipes.description: Forge and sharpen a practical iron field knife.
recipes.purpose: Supplies an early tool used by Hunting and Leatherworking.

recipes.description: Forge an iron axe head and mount it to a common timber handle.
recipes.purpose: Creates the first Smithing-to-Woodcutting tool connection.

recipes.description: Forge an iron pick head and mount it to a common timber haft.
recipes.purpose: Closes the early Mining-to-Smithing feedback loop.

recipes.description: Forge one iron bar into a batch of common arrowheads.
recipes.purpose: Creates a repeatable early Smithing sink through Fletching ammunition.

recipes.description: Rework and carbon-treat iron at a controlled forge to produce stronger steel.
recipes.purpose: Extends common iron into the durable middle tier without adding a single-purpose fuel item.
recipes.notes: Forge fuel and carbon treatment are station-supplied process costs rather than inventory items.

recipes.description: Forge a durable steel field knife with a long-wearing edge.
recipes.purpose: Upgrades the shared Hunting and Leatherworking cutting tool.

recipes.description: Forge one steel bar into a batch of hardened arrowheads.
recipes.purpose: Maintains a recurring middle-tier metal sink through Fletching.

recipes.description: Forge and mount a reinforced steel axe for sustained selective cutting.
recipes.purpose: Carries the Smithing-to-Woodcutting tool connection into middle progression.

recipes.description: Forge a hardened steel pickaxe for dense ridge and volcanic stone.
recipes.purpose: Unlocks the durable Mining tool needed for Emberholt progression.

recipes.description: Draw and shape an iron bar into standardized nails, pins, and brackets.
recipes.purpose: Keeps basic iron relevant in later repair, mechanisms, and fabrication economies.

recipes.description: Seat concentrated Ember Shards into prepared steel arrowheads.
recipes.purpose: Creates a focused recurring sink for Ember Shards while leaving final ammunition to Fletching.

recipes.description: Alloy steel with stable emberstone and a concentrated Ember Shard under controlled Emberholt heat.
recipes.purpose: Connects early iron, middle steel, and Emberholt mining into one canon capstone material.
recipes.notes: The recipe expresses the canon alloy relationship without making Ashsteel directly gatherable.

recipes.description: Forge and finish an Ashsteel field knife for demanding material work.
recipes.purpose: Provides the capstone shared Hunting and Leatherworking knife.

recipes.description: Forge an Ashsteel axe head and mount it to a replaceable common timber handle.
recipes.purpose: Provides the capstone Smithing-to-Woodcutting tool and retains common timber demand.

recipes.description: Forge an Ashsteel pick head and mount it to a replaceable common timber haft.
recipes.purpose: Closes the capstone Mining tool loop without requiring a quest material.

recipes.description: Forge one Ashsteel bar into a precise batch of capstone arrowheads.
recipes.purpose: Creates a recurring high-level Ashsteel sink through Fletching ammunition.
